scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run example:compile && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.example:compile: node dist/cli.js compile examples/counter/Counter.meeko examples/counter/Counter.generated.ts && node dist/cli.js compile examples/attributes/Attributes.meeko examples/attributes/Attributes.generated.ts
scripts.example:bundle: pnpm run build && pnpm run example:compile && esbuild examples/counter/client.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=examples/counter/client.bundle.js
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run example:check && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
